verdict.rationale: ScrapingBee has automation features, including JS scenarios and cron-based CLI schedules, so a buyer could fairly ask about versioning them. However, nothing in the evidence shows it can version, review history of, or roll back those automations. Schedules and scenarios are adjacent features, not versioning or rollback, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can version, review, and roll back my automations
